units.source_text: 说也奇怪，这是第一次传到我耳朵里的社会批评。

en.t: Strangely enough, this was the first social criticism ever to reach my ears.

units.source_text: 我们属于僧侣的世界，学校也是在这个世界里，寺庙彼此之间没有开展批评。

en.t: We belonged to the world of monks; the school was inside that world too, and there was no criticism exchanged among the temples.

units.source_text: 但是，老董事们的这番对话，丝毫也不使我感到震惊。

en.t: But this conversation among the old directors did not shock me in the slightest.

units.source_text: 这些都是明摆着的事情！

en.t: All of these things were perfectly obvious!
We had been made to eat cold leftovers.
The teacher often went out to amuse himself in Gion...

units.source_text: 对我来说，用老董事们的这种理解方法来理解我，使我产生了一种不可言喻的厌恶感。

en.t: For me, being understood through the old directors' way of understanding filled me with an indescribable disgust.

units.source_text: 以"他们的语言"来理解我，使我难以容忍。

en.t: To be understood in "their language" was more than I could bear.

units.source_text: "我的语言"同"他们的语言"是截然不同的。

en.t: "My language" was utterly different from "their language."

units.source_text: 即使看到老师同抵园的艺妓一起行走，我希望他们也能想起我不会陷入任何道德上的厌恶。

en.t: Even if they saw the teacher walking with a Gion geisha, I wanted them to remember that I would not fall into any moral revulsion.
